label: IoT 55 Automation
info: Telemetry validation, state machine, scheduler, events and dashboard API

name: Validate, state machine and rules
initialize: if (!flow.get('iot55')) flow.set('iot55', { online: false, storeStatus: 'OPEN', presence: false, relay: false, mode: 'AUTO', override: false, threshold: 700, currentSignal: 0, systemState: 'OFFLINE', events: [], history: [], pendingSince: 0, lastTelemetry: 0 });

name: Event log
Build validated command
func: const body = typeof msg.payload === 'string' ? JSON.parse(msg.payload || '{}') : (msg.payload || {}); const allowed = ['ON','OFF','AUTO','OVERRIDE','CLEAR_OVERRIDE']; if (!allowed.includes(body.command)) { msg.statusCode = 400; msg.payload = { error: 'Unsupported command' }; return [null, msg]; } let topic = 'iot55/device01/cmd/relay'; let payload = { command: body.command === 'AUTO' ? 'ON' : body.command === 'OVERRIDE' || body.command === 'CLEAR_OVERRIDE' ? 'ON' : body.command, source: 'DASHBOARD', timestamp_ms: Date.now() }; if (body.command === 'AUTO') { topic = 'iot55/device01/cmd/override'; payload = { override: 'CLEAR', source: 'DASHBOARD', timestamp_ms: Date.now() }; } else if (body.command === 'OVERRIDE') { topic = 'iot55/device01/cmd/override'; payload = { override: 'ACTIVE', source: 'DASHBOARD', timestamp_ms: Date.now() }; } else if (body.command === 'CLEAR_OVERRIDE') { topic = 'iot55/device01/cmd/override'; payload = { override: 'CLEAR', source: 'DASHBOARD', timestamp_ms: Date.now() }; } msg.topic = topic; msg.payload = JSON.stringify(payload); return [msg, null];

name: Command accepted
func: msg.headers = { 'content-type': 'application/json' }; msg.payload = JSON.stringify({ accepted: true }); return msg;

name: Opening and closing scheduler
func: const state = flow.get('iot55') || {}; const open = env.get('STORE_OPEN_TIME') || '08:00'; const close = env.get('STORE_CLOSE_TIME') || '22:00'; const hhmm = new Date().toTimeString().slice(0,5); let status = hhmm >= open && hhmm < close ? 'OPEN' : 'CLOSED'; if (state.storeStatus !== status) { state.storeStatus = status; flow.set('iot55', state); msg.topic = 'iot55/device01/status'; msg.payload = JSON.stringify({ device_id: 'device01', store_status: status, source: 'SCHEDULER', timestamp_ms: Date.now() }); return msg; } return null;
